They say: Why hath not an angel been sent down unto him? If We sent down an angel, then the matter would be judged; no further time would be allowed them (for reflection)

And Moses said unto his people: Seek help in Allah and endure. Lo! the earth is Allah's. He giveth it for an inheritance to whom He will. And lo! the sequel is for those who keep their duty (unto Him)
A party hath He led aright, while error hath just hold over (another) party, for lo! they choose the devils for protecting supporters instead of Allah and deem that they are rightly guided
Shall We utterly ignore you because ye are a wanton folk
And when We said unto the angels: Fall prostrate before Adam, they fell prostrate (all) save Iblis; he refused
And had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, and that Allah is Clement, Wise, (ye had been undone)

Is he who founded his building upon duty to Allah and His good pleasure better; or he who founded his building on the brink of a crumbling, overhanging precipice so that it toppled with him into the fire of hell? Allah guideth not wrongdoing folk

Ye will find others who desire that they should have security from you, and security from their own folk. So often as they are returned to hostility they are plunged therein. If they keep not aloof from you nor offer you peace nor hold their hands, then take them and kill them wherever ye find them. Against such We have given you clear warrant

Say: Obey Allah and obey the messenger. But if ye turn away, then (it is) for him (to do) only that wherewith he hath been charged, and for you (to do) only that wherewith ye have been charged. If ye obey him, ye will go aright. But the messenger hath no other charge than to convey (the message) plainly
And indeed they supposed, even as ye suppose, that Allah would not raise anyone (from the dead)
Lo! the hypocrites seek to beguile Allah, but it is He Who beguileth them. When they stand up to worship they perform it languidly and to be seen of men, and are mindful of Allah but little

Race one with another for forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whereof the breadth is as the breadth of the heavens and the earth, which is in store for those who believe in Allah and His messengers. Such is the bounty of Allah, which He bestoweth upon whom He will, and Allah is of Infinite Bounty
And dutiful toward his parents. And he was not arrogant, rebellious
They had naught against them save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty, the Owner of Praise
And Allah would turn to you in mercy; but those who follow vain desires would have you go tremendously astray
See how We prefer one of them above another, and verily the Hereafter will be greater in degrees and greater in preferment

And when there cometh unto them a messenger from Allah, confirming that which they possess, a party of those who have received the Scripture fling the Scripture of Allah behind their backs as if they knew not
And He giveth you of all ye ask of Him, and if ye would count the bounty of Allah ye cannot reckon it. Lo! man is verily a wrong-doer, an ingrate
Unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. And Allah is sufficient as Defender
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

Those who disbelieve say: The Hour will never come unto us. Say: Nay, by my Lord, but it is coming unto you surely. (He is) the Knower of the Unseen. Not an atom's weight, or less than that or greater, escapeth Him in the heavens or in the earth, but it is in a clear Record
They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision
Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the like of them? Aye, that He is! for He is the All-Wise Creator
Say: O mankind! I am only a plain warner unto you
I convey unto you the messages of my Lord and am for you a true adviser

And slay them wherever ye find them, and drive them out of the places whence they drove you out, for persecution is worse than slaughter. And fight not with them at the Inviolable Place of Worship until they first attack you there, but if they attack you (there) then slay them. Such is the reward of disbelievers

If only there had been among the generations before you men possessing a remnant (of good sense) to warn (their people) from corruption in the earth, as did a few of those whom We saved from them! The wrong-doers followed that by which they were made sapless, and were guilty
Ye are more awful as a fear in their bosoms than Allah. That is because they are a folk who understand not
Will they then not meditate on the Qur'an, or are there locks on the hearts
The guilty will be known by their marks, and will be taken by the forelocks and the feet
O People of the Scripture! Why will ye argue about Abraham, when the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed till after him? Have ye then no sense
And the hills are set in motion and become as a mirage
Await they aught save the Hour, that it shall come upon them suddenly, when they know not

And this Qur'an is not such as could ever be invented in despite of Allah; but it is a confirmation of that which was before it and an exposition of that which is decreed for mankind - Therein is no doubt - from the Lord of the Worlds
Their prayer therein will be: Glory be to Thee, O Allah! and their greeting therein will be: Peace. And the conclusion of their prayer will be: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds
He from whom (such retribution) is averted on that day, (Allah) hath in truth had mercy on him. That will be the signal triumph
Lo! We have appointed it a Lecture, in Arabic that haply ye may understand

And her Lord accepted her with full acceptance and vouchsafed to her a goodly growth; and made Zachariah her guardian. Whenever Zachariah went into the sanctuary where she was, he found that she had food. He said: O Mary! Whence cometh unto thee this (food)? She answered: It is from Allah. Allah giveth without stint to whom He will
And it will be said: This day We forget you, even as ye forgot the meeting of this your day; and your habitation is the Fire, and there is none to help you
And some part of the night awake for it, a largess for thee. It may be that thy Lord will raise thee to a praised estate
We said: Fear not! Lo! thou art the higher

Such were the townships. We relate some tidings of them unto thee (Muhammad). Their messengers verily came unto them with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), but they could not believe because they had before denied. Thus doth Allah print upon the hearts of disbelievers (that they hear not)
And when he reached it, he was called by name: O Moses

Verily we have honoured the Children of Adam. We carry them on the land and the sea, and have made provision of good things for them, and have preferred them above many of those whom We created with a marked preferment
And they said: Whatever portent thou bringest wherewith to bewitch us, we shall not put faith in thee

Nor unto those whom, when they came to thee (asking) that thou shouldst mount them, thou didst tell: I cannot find whereon to mount you. They turned back with eyes flowing with tears, for sorrow that they could not find the means to spend
Lo! that which ye are promised will surely come to pass, and ye cannot escape
And when We gave unto Moses the Scripture and the criterion (of right and wrong), that ye might be led aright
They say: When we are dead and have become (mere) dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again
Whereon every wise command is made clear

Their reward is with their Lord: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they dwell for ever. Allah hath pleasure in them and they have pleasure in Him. This is (in store) for him who feareth his Lord
Say: Allah I worship, making my religion pure for Him (only)
Nothing of our revelation (even a single verse) do we abrogate or cause be forgotten, but we bring (in place) one better or the like thereof. Knowest thou not that Allah is Able to do all things
And when Our revelations are recited unto him he turneth away in pride as if he heard them not, as if there were a deafness in his ears. So give him tidings of a painful doom

Then He ordained them seven heavens in two Days and inspired in each heaven its mandate; and We decked the nether heaven with lamps, and rendered it inviolable. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Knower
On the day when the wrong-doer gnaweth his hands, he will say: Ah, would that I had chosen a way together with the messenger (of Allah)
When their brother Hud said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)
Say: O my people! Act in your manner. Lo! I (too) am acting. Thus ye will come to know
Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for him who feareth
And if ye wish to exchange one wife for another and ye have given unto one of them a sum of money (however great), take nothing from it. Would ye take it by the way of calumny and open wrong
He Who created all the pairs, and appointed for you ships and cattle whereupon ye ride
Then We revived you after your extinction, that ye might give thanks
Which leapeth up over the hearts (of men)
And We made plain the case to him, that the root of them (who did wrong) was to be cut at early morn

The chieftains of his people, who were scornful, said: Surely we will drive thee out, O Shu'eyb, and those who believe with thee, from our township, unless ye return to our religion. He said: Even though we hate it
And he is indeed a failure who stunteth it

When those who disbelieve had set up in their hearts zealotry, the zealotry of the Age of Ignorance, then Allah sent down His peace of reassurance upon His messenger and upon the believers and imposed on them the word of self-restraint, for they were worthy of it and meet for it. And Allah is Aware of all things
When the night grew dark upon him he beheld a star. He said: This is my Lord. But when it set, he said: I love not things that set
And who doth greater wrong than he who is reminded of the revelations of his Lord, then turneth from them. Lo! We shall requite the guilty
And they believed, therefor We gave them comfort for a while
Each (of them) We warned by examples, and each (of them) We brought to utter ruin
Is he who relieth on a clear proof from his Lord like those for whom the evil that they do is beautified while they follow their own lusts
And hath cast out all that was in her, and is empty
He hath no partner. This am I commanded, and I am first of those who surrender (unto Him)
The Night of Power is better than a thousand months
Have they not seen how We have created for them of Our handiwork the cattle, so that they are their owners
Wherein they will abide for ever. They will find (then) no protecting friend nor helper
Except those who repent and amend and make manifest (the truth). These it is toward whom I relent. I am the Relenting, the Merciful
Endure the heat thereof, and whether ye are patient of it or impatient of it is all one for you. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do
And those who believe and do good works and believe in that which is revealed unto Muhammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He riddeth them of their ill-deeds and improveth their state
Bethink you: If it is from Allah and ye reject it - Who is further astray than one who is at open feud (with Allah)
And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful
And if Allah had not decreed migration for them, He verily would have punished them in the world, and theirs in the Hereafter is the punishment of the Fire
Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High
But verily We shall cause those who disbelieve to taste an awful doom, and verily We shall requite them the worst of what they used to do
He said: Lo! thou art of those reprieved
We appointed immortality for no mortal before thee. What! if thou diest, can they be immortal
He said: Then go down hence! It is not for thee to show pride here, so go forth! Lo! thou art of those degraded
Follow that which is inspired in thee from thy Lord; there is no Allah save Him; and turn away from the idolaters
And verily ye know the first creation. Why, then, do ye not reflect
Mankind were but one community; then they differed; and had it not been for a word that had already gone forth from thy Lord it had been judged between them in respect of that wherein they differ
We are Best Aware of what they wish to hear when they give ear to thee and when they take secret counsel, when the evil-doers say: Ye follow but a man bewitched
As for those who strive in Us, We surely guide them to Our paths, and lo! Allah is with the good
And verily most of the men of old went astray before them
Nay, but doth their knowledge reach to the Hereafter? Nay, for they are in doubt concerning it. Nay, for they cannot see it
Say: He it is Who multiplieth you in the earth, and unto Whom ye will be gathered
And We left for him among the later folk (the salutation)
And cannot give them help, nor can they help themselves
And every nation hath its term, and when its term cometh, they cannot put it off an hour nor yet advance (it)
Hath your Lord then distinguished you (O men of Makka) by giving you sons, and hath chosen for Himself females from among the angels? Lo! verily ye speak an awful word
Is he who goeth groping on his face more rightly guided, or he who walketh upright on a straight road

But as for those who believe and do good works We shall bring them into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide for ever. It is a promise from Allah in truth; and who can be more truthful than Allah in utterance
Or they say: He hath invented it. Say: Then bring ten surahs, the like thereof, invented, and call on everyone ye can beside Allah, if ye are truthful
There is none in the heavens and the earth but cometh unto the Beneficent as a slave
He is the Omnipotent over His slaves, and He is the Wise, the Knower
Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is
Such are they who have lost their souls, and that which they used to invent hath failed them

When Allah showed them unto thee (O Muhammad) in thy dream as few in number, and if He had shown them to thee as many, ye (Muslims) would have faltered and would have quarrelled over the affair. But Allah saved (you). Lo! He knoweth what is in the breasts (of men)

How can there be a treaty with Allah and with His messenger for the idolaters save those with whom ye made a treaty at the Inviolable Place of Worship? So long as they are true to you, be true to them. Lo! Allah loveth those who keep their duty
He said: Shall I seek for you a god other than Allah when He hath favoured you above (all) creatures
The road (of blame) is only against those who ask for leave of thee (to stay at home) when they are rich. They are content to be with the useless. Allah hath sealed their hearts so that they know not
Lo! ye come with lust unto men instead of women. Nay, but ye are wanton folk
And how many angels are in the heavens whose intercession availeth naught save after Allah giveth leave to whom He chooseth and accepteth
Outcast, and theirs is a perpetual torment
They said: Wonderest thou at the commandment of Allah? The mercy of Allah and His blessings be upon you, O people of the house! Lo! He is Owner of Praise, Owner of Glory
That is their reward because they disbelieved Our revelations and said: When we are bones and fragments shall we, forsooth, be raised up as a new creation
But Allah took him up unto Himself. Allah was ever Mighty, Wise
If He will, He can be rid of you and bring (instead of you) some new creation
He is only a man who hath invented a lie about Allah. We are not going to put faith in him
Or thou have a garden of date-palms and grapes, and cause rivers to gush forth therein abundantly
And We caused a tree of gourd to grow above him
Can we, when we are dead and have become mere dust and bones - can we (then) verily be brought to book

He said: I shall betake me to some mountain that will save me from the water. (Noah) said: This day there is none that saveth from the commandment of Allah save him on whom He hath had mercy. And the wave came in between them, so he was among the drowned
And when he saw their hands reached not to it, he mistrusted them and conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! Lo! we are sent unto the folk of Lot
Then after them We brought forth other generations
Among them are unlettered folk who know the Scripture not except from hearsay. They but guess
Allah sendeth down water from the sky and therewith reviveth the earth after her death. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for a folk who hear
And that which they were wont to count as gain availed them not
That is because they were opposed to Allah and His messenger; and whoso is opposed to Allah, (for him) verily Allah is stern in reprisal

Our Lord! And make them enter the Gardens of Eden which thou hast promised them, with such of their fathers and their wives and their descendants as do right. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Mighty, the Wise
He said: Go down hence, both of you, one of you a foe unto the other. But when there come unto you from Me a guidance, then whoso followeth My guidance, he will not go astray nor come to grief
Which only the most wretched must endure
Say: My Lord! If Thou shouldst show me that which they are promised
And even if We opened unto them a gate of heaven and they kept mounting through it
And We made it an example to their own and to succeeding generations, and an admonition to the Allah-fearing

Or some created thing that is yet greater in your thoughts! Then they will say: Who shall bring us back (to life). Say: He Who created you at the first. Then will they shake their heads at thee, and say: When will it be? Say: It will perhaps be soon
And thou seest many of them vying one with another in sin and transgression and their devouring of illicit gain. Verily evil is what they do
Such have guidance from their Lord. Such are the successful
Thus were they there defeated and brought low
None punisheth as He will punish on that day
That (is so). And whoso hath retaliated with the like of that which he was made to suffer and then hath (again) been wronged, Allah will succour him. Lo! Allah verily is Mild, Forgiving
And when harm toucheth men they cry unto their Lord, turning to Him in repentance; then, when they have tasted of His mercy, behold! some of them attribute partners to their Lord
In their hearts is a disease, and Allah increaseth their disease. A painful doom is theirs because they lie
For those who disbelieve and debar (men) from the way of Allah, We add doom to doom because they wrought corruption
But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke
Or have they chosen gods from the earth who raise the dead
Those who ward off (evil) are not accountable for them in aught, but the Reminder (must be given them) that haply they (too) may ward off (evil)
Those who have been given knowledge see that what is revealed unto thee from thy Lord is the truth and leadeth unto the path of the Mighty, the Owner of Praise
Nay, but the record of the vile is in Sijjin
They said: Lo! these are two wizards who would drive you out from your country by their magic, and destroy your best traditions
He who obeyeth Allah and His messenger, and feareth Allah, and keepeth duty (unto Him): such indeed are the victorious
He will forgive you your sins and bring you into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, and pleasant dwellings in Gardens of Eden. That is the supreme triumph
Say: Serve ye in place of Allah that which possesseth for you neither hurt nor use? Allah it is Who is the Hearer, the Knower
Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an, a revelation
Save him who bringeth unto Allah a whole heart
A bounty from thy Lord. That is the supreme triumph
This is a declaration for mankind, a guidance and an admonition unto those who ward off (evil)
Lo! We purified them with a pure thought, remembrance of the Home (of the Hereafter)
Say: Who is he who can preserve you from Allah if He intendeth harm for you, or intendeth mercy for you. They will not find that they have any friend or helper other than Allah
And (remember) when We did deliver you from Pharaoh's folk who were afflicting you with dreadful torment, slaughtering your sons and sparing your women. That was a tremendous trial from your Lord

Ye serve instead of Allah only idols, and ye only invent a lie. Lo! those whom ye serve instead of Allah own no provision for you. So seek your provision from Allah, and serve Him, and give thanks unto Him, (for) unto Him ye will be brought back
Say: In Whose hand is the dominion over all things and He protecteth, while against Him there is no protection, if ye have knowledge
And the agony of death cometh in truth. (And it is said unto him): This is that which thou wast wont to shun
He it is Who hath sent His messenger with the guidance and the Religion of Truth, that He may cause it to prevail over all religion, however much the idolaters may be averse
And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful
Beyond them there is hell, and that which they have earned will naught avail them, nor those whom they have chosen for protecting friends beside Allah. Theirs will be an awful doom
They answer: Nay, but ye (yourselves) were not believers
Lo! I, even I, am Allah, There is no Allah save Me. So serve Me and establish worship for My remembrance
Ask of the Children of Israel how many a clear revelation We gave them! He who altereth the grace of Allah after it hath come unto him (for him), lo! Allah is severe in punishment
When ye sought help of your Lord and He answered you (saying): I will help you with a thousand of the angels, rank on rank
With bowls and ewers and a cup from a pure spring
And the consequence for both will be that they are in the Fire, therein abiding. Such is the reward of evil-doers
He said: I did it then, when I was of those who are astray
Thou wilt see the guilty on that day linked together in chains

He maketh the night to pass into the day and He maketh the day to pass into the night. He hath subdued the sun and moon to service. Each runneth unto an appointed term. Such is Allah, your Lord; His is the Sovereignty; and those unto whom ye pray instead of Him own not so much as the white spot on a date-stone
And verily we have written in the Scripture, after the Reminder: My righteous slaves will inherit the earth

Will ye not fight a folk who broke their solemn pledges, and purposed to drive out the messenger and did attack you first? What! Fear ye them? Now Allah hath more right that ye should fear Him, if ye are believers
Till, when he cometh unto Us, he saith (unto his comrade): Ah, would that between me and thee there were the distance of the two horizons - an evil comrade
But when it cometh home to them, then it will be a hapless morn for those who have been warned
One among them said: Kill not Joseph but, if ye must be doing, fling him into the depth of the pit; some caravan will find him
He saith: My Lord knoweth what is spoken in the heaven and the earth. He is the Hearer, the Knower
A stalwart of the jinn said: I will bring it thee before thou canst rise from thy place. Lo! I verily am strong and trusty for such work
And they used to hew out dwellings from the hills, (wherein they dwelt) secure
He saith: Begone therein, and speak not unto Me
Degrees of rank from Him, and forgiveness and mercy. Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful

And for such of your women as despair of menstruation, if ye doubt, their period (of waiting) shall be three months, along with those who have it not. And for those with child, their period shall be till they bring forth their burden. And whosoever keepeth his duty to Allah, He maketh his course easy for him
And when the messengers came unto the family of Lot
And other faces, on that day, with dust upon them

And when thou bringest not a verse for them they say: Why hast thou not chosen it? Say: I follow only that which is inspired in me from my Lord. This (Qur'an) is insight from your Lord, and a guidance and a mercy for a people that believe
Say: Flight will not avail you if ye flee from death or killing, and then ye dwell in comfort but a little while

Vile women are for vile men, and vile men for vile women. Good women are for good men, and good men for good women; such are innocent of that which people say: For them is pardon and a bountiful provision
But be patient (O Muhammad) with a patience fair to see
And seek ye out strongholds, that haply ye may last for ever
Those who break the covenant of Allah after ratifying it, and sever that which Allah ordered to be joined, and (who) make mischief in the earth: Those are they who are the losers

Thou causest the night to pass into the day, and Thou causest the day to pass into the night. And Thou bringest forth the living from the dead, and Thou bringest forth the dead from the living. And Thou givest sustenance to whom Thou choosest, without stint
Save from their wives or the (slaves) that their right hands possess, for then they are not blameworthy
Then We said: Go together unto the folk who have denied Our revelations. Then We destroyed them, a complete destruction
Saying: O our father! We went racing one with another, and left Joseph by our things, and the wolf devoured him, and thou believest not our saying even when we speak the truth
Lo! We have sent thee (O Muhammad) as a witness and a bearer of good tidings and a warner

The lightning almost snatcheth away their sight from them. As often as it flasheth forth for them they walk therein, and when it darkeneth against them they stand still. If Allah willed, He could destroy their hearing and their sight. Lo! Allah is able to do all things
Who establish worship and spend of that We have bestowed on them
He said: Didst thou see, when we took refuge on the rock, and I forgot the fish - and none but Satan caused me to forget to mention it - it took its way into the waters by a marvel
Thus we have revealed it as a Lecture in Arabic, and have displayed therein certain threats, that peradventure they may keep from evil or that it may cause them to take heed
He said: O Iblis! What hindereth thee from falling prostrate before that which I have created with both My hands? Art thou too proud or art thou of the high exalted
They shall have what they will of their Lord's bounty. That is the reward of the good
Fill the measure when ye measure, and weigh with a right balance; that is meet, and better in the end
Say: Lo! I control not hurt nor benefit for you
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
Have ye taken security from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not cause the earth to swallow you when lo! it is convulsed
And when they had gone further, he said unto his servant: Bring us our breakfast. Verily we have found fatigue in this our journey

The Messiah, son of Mary, was no other than a messenger, messengers (the like of whom) had passed away before him. And his mother was a saintly woman. And they both used to eat (earthly) food. See how We make the revelations clear for them, and see how they are turned away
And left for him among the later folk (the salutation)
When the caravan departed their father had said: Truly I am conscious of the breath of Joseph, though ye call me dotard
If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not be able to drive off the fire from their faces and from their backs, and they will not be helped
And ask those of Our messengers whom We sent before thee: Did We ever appoint gods to be worshipped beside the Beneficent
Lo! it is naught else than a reminder for all peoples
When they are flung therein they hear its roaring as it boileth up

Lo! those of you who turned back on the day when the two hosts met, Satan alone it was who caused them to backslide, because of some of that which they have earned. Now Allah hath forgiven them. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Clement
And if a bounty from Allah befell you, he would surely cry, as if there had been no love between you and him: Oh, would that I had been with them, then should I have achieved a great success
Are they who plan ill-deeds then secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them, or that the doom will not come on them whence they know not
And verily they had already sworn unto Allah that they would not turn their backs (to the foe). An oath to Allah must be answered for
She said: Lo! kings, when they enter a township, ruin it and make the honour of its people shame. Thus will they do
And (remember) when ye slew a man and disagreed concerning it and Allah brought forth that which ye were hiding
This is the Creation of Allah. Now show me that which those (ye worship) beside Him have created. Nay, but the wrong-doers are in error manifest
But if thou turn away from them, seeking mercy from thy Lord, for which thou hopest, then speak unto them a reasonable word

Thus have We appointed unto every prophet an adversary - devils of humankind and jinn who inspire in one another plausible discourse through guile. If thy Lord willed, they would not do so; so leave them alone with their devising
Will ye be left secure in that which is here before us
On the day when their tongues and their hands and their feet testify against them as to what they used to do
When they come unto you (Muslims), they say: We believe; but they came in unbelief and they went out in the same; and Allah knoweth best what they were hiding

Fear ye to offer alms before your conference? Then, when ye do it not and Allah hath forgiven you, establish worship and pay the poor-due and obey Allah and His messenger. And Allah is Aware of what ye do
But as for him who hoardeth and deemeth himself independent
And Solomon was David's heir. And he said: O mankind! Lo! we have been taught the language of birds, and have been given (abundance) of all things. This surely is evident favour
He said: And what knowledge have I of what they may have been doing (in the past)

That they may witness things that are of benefit to them, and mention the name of Allah on appointed days over the beast of cattle that He hath bestowed upon them. Then eat thereof and feed therewith the poor unfortunate
Have they not seen the earth, how much of every fruitful kind We make to grow therein

Thus have their (so-called) partners (of Allah) made the killing of their children to seem fair unto many of the idolaters, that they may ruin them and make their faith obscure for them. Had Allah willed (it otherwise), they had not done so. So leave them alone with their devices
O ye who believe! Observe your duty to Allah with right observance, and die not save as those who have surrendered (unto Him)
And We blessed him and Isaac. And of their seed are some who do good, and some who plainly wrong themselves
And when Abraham said unto his father and his folk: Lo! I am innocent of what ye worship
And lo! of his persuasion verily was Abraham

And with how many a prophet have there been a number of devoted men who fought (beside him). They quailed not for aught that befell them in the way of Allah, nor did they weaken, nor were they brought low. Allah loveth the steadfast

Say (unto them O Muhammad): I am only a mortal like you. It is inspired in me that your Allah is One Allah, therefor take the straight path unto Him and seek forgiveness of Him. And woe unto the idolaters
Then why did those whom they had chosen for gods as a way of approach (unto Allah) not help them? Nay, but they did fail them utterly. And (all) that was their lie, and what they used to invent
Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered
Each do We supply, both these and those, from the bounty of thy Lord. And the bounty of thy Lord can never be walled up
Warn them (O Muhammad) of the Day of the approaching (doom), when the hearts will be choking the throats, (when) there will be no friend for the wrong-doers, nor any intercessor who will be heard
They said: O Dhu'l-Qarneyn! Lo! Gog and Magog are spoiling the land. So may we pay thee tribute on condition that thou set a barrier between us and them
And the (awful) Cry overtook those who did wrong, so that morning found them prostrate in their dwellings

And when it is recited unto them, they say: We believe in it. Lo! it is the Truth from our Lord. Lo! even before it we were of those who surrender (unto Him)
